summary: You choose Russian Language (three intermediate Russian courses and at least three SLAVIC courses) or Russian Language, Literature, and Culture (three of SLAVIC 145-148 and more SLAVIC courses), at least six courses of 3 units or more and 24 units in all, letter graded where a letter grade is offered. First-year Russian does not count, and approved courses from other departments are moved in by hand. The units cannot count toward another major or minor, and transfer and AP credit are not accepted; you check those yourself.
